title: Article 354 — Application of provisions relating to distribution of revenues while a Proclamation of Emergency is in operation

content.overview: Article 354 provides that the President may, while a Proclamation of Emergency is in operation, by order alter or modify the financial distribution provisions of Articles 268–279 for the period of the Emergency and for a maximum of the financial year in which the Proclamation ceases. Every such order is to be laid before each House of Parliament.
content.glance: During National Emergency, President may by order modify Centre–State revenue distribution (Arts 268–279) for the Emergency period and up to the end of that financial year; order laid before Parliament.
content.study:
Article 354 allows temporary modification of the constitutional scheme of distribution of revenues between the Union and the States during a National Emergency.

Examination: Presidential order; Arts 268–279; duration limited; laid before Parliament.

sections.heading: Key rule
sections.body: President may by order modify application of Arts 268–279 during Emergency (and up to end of the financial year in which Emergency ends). Order to be laid before each House of Parliament.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 354 provide?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 354 provides that while a Proclamation of Emergency is in operation, the President may by order direct that all or any of the provisions of Articles 268 to 279 relating to distribution of revenues shall have effect subject to such exceptions or modifications as the President thinks fit, for the period of the Emergency and for a period not extending in any case beyond the expiration of the financial year in which the Proclamation ceases to operate. Every such order shall be laid before each House of Parliament.

examTips: Modify revenue distribution during National Emergency; order before Parliament.

keyTakeaways: Art 354: temporary modification of revenue distribution during Emergency.
